# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Modern UWP integration**

## Highlights

Upcoming changes add CPU and ANGLE-backed GPU controls for modern .NET UWP applications. The new UWP views use Windows.UI.Xaml and distinct UWP packages while sharing rendering implementation with WinUI. This does not restore legacy uap10.0 support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Platform

- **Modern .NET UWP support** — SkiaSharp.Views.UWP targets net10.0-windows10.0.26100.0 with a declared Windows minimum of 10.0.17763.0. SkiaSharp.NativeAssets.UWP supplies ANGLE and the UWP helper for win-x86, win-x64 and win-arm64, reusing Win32 Skia and HarfBuzz binaries. The documented XAML build and deployment workflow requires Visual Studio 2026 MSBuild; this is not Store-certification evidence. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))

## API Surface

- **CPU and GPU XAML controls** — SKXamlCanvas provides CPU drawing and SKSwapChainPanel provides ANGLE-backed GPU drawing, with UWP extensions and PaintSurface event arguments. Surfaces are control-managed: the CPU surface is disposed after the callback, and GPU resources are released with the context. DPI tracking falls back to DisplayInformation when XamlRoot is unavailable. — ❤️ [@FoggyFinder](https://github.com/FoggyFinder) ([#4540](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4540))
